sections.title: Explanation
sections.content: The suffix -ban/-ben expresses being inside a place. Use -ban after back-vowel words and -ben after front-vowel words.

items.english: I am in the living room.

sections.content: Vowel harmony like this isn’t unique to Hungarian — Turkish and Finnish do very similar things, quietly adjusting suffixes to match the vowels already in a word. If that sounds intimidating, flip it around: you’re training your ear on a feature only a handful of language families bother with, which is a genuinely rare skill to pick up.
